_comment: Advisories `make audit-mobile` tolerates. Only for advisories with NO patched release that reach only build/test tooling, never the app binary. Every entry needs a reason and a reviewBy date; the gate fails once reviewBy passes, forcing a re-check.

advisories.reason: No patched release (latest 3.0.3 is in range <=3.0.3). Reached only via micromatch in Metro's file map and Jest, which run at build/test time and never ship in the app.

No patched release (latest 1.4.0 is in range <=1.4.0). Reached only via @expo/cli -> @expo/code-signing-certificates, used for EAS Update code signing, which this app does not configure. Build tooling, never in the app.
